name: AG News: News Topic Classification Benchmark
description: AG News is a benchmark dataset for text topic classification constructed by Xiang Zhang, Junbo Zhao, and Yann LeCun (NeurIPS 2015) from Antonio Gulli's AG corpus of news articles. The dataset contains 120,000 training samples and 7,600 test samples equally distributed across 4 topical classes: World, Sports, Business, and Sci/Tech. Each sample consists of the news article title and description fields gathered by the ComeToMyHead academic search engine across more than 2,000 news sources between 2004 and 2005.

publisher.name: University of Pisa & New York University

license.name: License not specified by source (Upstream non-commercial research corpus)
license.notes: The exact 4-class topic classification benchmark (120,000 train, 7,600 test articles) was constructed by Xiang Zhang, Junbo Zhao, and Yann LeCun (NeurIPS 2015) and distributed in CSV format without an explicit dataset license. It was derived from Antonio Gulli's AG corpus of news articles, which was collected by the ComeToMyHead academic engine and made available with non-commercial research terms and redistribution limitations. Underlying news text remains copyrighted by source news organizations. Because the specific 4-class benchmark distribution does not carry an explicit dataset license, its status is unspecified by source and commercial usability remains unknown.
